photos.c: Sprint star Amala enters the Junior ranks. A "veteran" of two Cup Finals and two seasons of dominating the Women's Southern League sprint events, it's a sobering thought that seventeen year-old sprint star Amala Onuora is only just entering the under 20 age group in 2003. As an under 17 she has accumulated a terrific series of pbs: 60m 7.8, 100m 12.0/12.01/11.97w, 200m 24.67w, 24.96, 24.96.

Below: Rachel King, Amala Onuora, Michelle Nestor and Caroline Wilson joined forces to win the 4 x 100m relay at the Golden Jubilee Cup Semi-Final and help push the score along to a massive 313 out of a maximum possible of 342.
